usage.notes: Panacea accesses ClinicalTrials.gov through its server adapter. The browser does not query the registry API directly.

license.scope: Registered study metadata retrieved from the public ClinicalTrials.gov API v2.
license.notes: Verify current API terms, attribution expectations and any downstream redistribution limits before expanding use.

validation.notes: Registration does not establish efficacy, safety, approval, recruitment suitability, or individual treatment appropriateness.

provenance.authority: U.S. National Library of Medicine / National Institutes of Health
provenance.notes: Preserve NCT identifier, official record URL, query and retrieval timestamp for every displayed study.

adapter.notes: Existing production adapter normalizes NCT ID, title, recruitment status, condition, phase and location.

trust.notes: Trust score applies to registry provenance and reproducibility of retrieval; it must not be interpreted as proof that a registered intervention works.
